newsitem.title: UK: EIB to price 1.0 bln Ecu-into-euro bond at +2 b.p.
newsitem.headline: EIB to price 1.0 bln Ecu-into-euro bond at +2 b.p.

text.p: The European Investment Bank will price its 1.0 billion Ecu-into-euro Eurobond due April 2004 at a spread of two basis points over the equivalent OAT, joint lead managers, Caisse des Depots et Consignations, Paribas and SBC Warburg said Friday.
The deal was launched earlier at an indicated 2-4 b.p. range.

The launch statement from the lead managers said: "Until the start of such third stage (of EMU), all monetary rights and obligations in respect of the (EIB) notes shall be deemed to be denominated in Ecu at the rate of one Ecu for one euro". The notes will be paid for in Ecu and coupons will be paid in Ecu until the introduction of the Euro.
